text.en:
Enhances your <strand/>Strand Grenade abilities:
• <strand/>Grapple Melees create 3 <strand/>Threadlings on hit
• <strand/>Threadling Grenade can be charged by holding [Grenade] to create a Threadling Nest on impact, which spawns 3 <strand/>Threadlings instantly and then one additional Threadling every 5 seconds for 17.5 seconds.
• <strand/>Shackle Grenade can be consumed by holding [Grenade], granting <strand/>'Weaver's Trance' for 25 seconds. Kills while Weaver's Trance is active trigger a ? meter radius explosion around the target that <strand/>Suspends enemies for 6? seconds
• <strand/>Slicewire Grenade can be charged by holding [Grenade] to drop 4 additional explosion submunitions, and ends with the creation of a Tangle (ignores global cooldowns)
